title: Defeat Hillock and enter Lioneye's Watch
summary: Stay close enough to keep attacking, sidestep his slow overhead slam, then enter town.
details: Pick up and equip the weapon beside your character before engaging.
You only need Hillock—do not clear the beach.
why: Hillock unlocks the first town, your first skill reward, vendors, and the campaign route.
speedrun: Fight beside the town gate so the exit is only a few steps away after the kill.

title: Claim your first reward and reach The Coast
summary: Take the build-appropriate gem, check vendors for linked sockets and movement-speed boots, then leave town quickly.
details: Socket colours and links matter more than item rarity during early leveling.
A three-link matching your planned skill can be a larger damage gain than a rare item.
speedrun: Know your reward and vendor targets before entering town; town indecision is one of the largest controllable time losses.

title: Collect the three glyphs in Mud Flats
summary: Open the three Rhoa nests, take every glyph, then use them at the large submerged wall.
details: You do not need to full-clear Mud Flats.
Keep moving sideways when Rhoas begin a charge.
warning: Do not leave with fewer than three glyphs; the wall will not open.
speedrun: The streams and shoreline geometry are more useful navigation cues than random monster packs.

title: Kill Hailrake and take the Medicine Chest
summary: Follow the shoreline route, kill Hailrake, take the chest, then use the planned relog back to town.
warning: Take the Medicine Chest before leaving Tidal Island.
speedrun: Keep the return trip short by relogging once the quest item is secured.

title: Defeat Brutus and leave immediately
summary: Complete the prison route, kill Brutus, then return to town for the movement-skill reward.
details: The Chemist's Strongbox is optional; only detour when it is close.
Keep moving during Brutus's wind-ups rather than trying to tank every hit.
speedrun: Use the logout/relog route after the boss instead of running backwards through the prison.

title: Finish Fairgraves while passing Ship Graveyard
summary: Complete the Fairgraves objective during the natural route through Ship Graveyard so it does not become a separate return trip.
speedrun: Bundle side objectives into the first pass through an area whenever the route already takes you beside them.

title: Defeat Merveil and begin Act 2
summary: Follow the water flow through the caverns, manage cold damage, and take the Southern Forest exit after the fight.
details: Cold resistance is unusually valuable for this fight.
Merveil's second phase is safer when you keep repositioning instead of standing in overlapping effects.
speedrun: The direction of flowing water is a repeatable layout clue for both Cavern of Anger and the lair.

title: Clear Chamber of Sins and take the Baleful Gem
summary: Complete the trial on league start, kill Fidelitas, take the Baleful Gem, and relog to town.
why: The Baleful Gem is mandatory for opening the path through the Vaal Ruins later in the act.
warning: Confirm the quest item is in your inventory before leaving the boss room.
speedrun: The waypoint on level two points toward the exit; start and boss arena tend to occupy opposing corners.

title: Kill The Weaver and secure Maligaro's Spike
summary: Follow the webbed passages to the nest, kill The Weaver, and pick up Maligaro's Spike.
details: The chambers are effectively linear once you identify the correct side of Western Forest.
Circle the arena to avoid being surrounded by spider adds.
why: Maligaro's Spike is required to remove the roots blocking the Vaal Ruins.
warning: Do not leave the arena without Maligaro's Spike.
speedrun: Search the side of Western Forest without the waypoint for Weaver's Chambers.

title: Resolve the bandits and reopen the road
summary: Follow the selected bandit plan exactly, then kill Captain Arteri and break the Thaumetic Seal.
details: The route changes depending on whether you help a bandit or kill all three.
The app keeps incompatible bandit branches hidden when your choice is set correctly.
why: Breaking the seal opens the passage that reconnects Act 1's Prisoner's Gate and completes The Way Forward.
speedrun: Use waypoints and planned relogs between bandit objectives instead of retracing Western Forest.

title: Defeat the Vaal Oversoul
summary: Climb the Ancient Pyramid, defeat the Oversoul, relog, and waypoint directly to the City of Sarn.
details: Move away when the boss raises an arm for a slam.
Do not wait beside the burrow point; continue clearing spawned enemies.
speedrun: After the first pyramid floor, staircases commonly alternate toward opposite corners.

title: Collect the three Platinum Busts
summary: Use the sewer landmarks to collect all three busts, activate the waypoint, and continue to the Marketplace.
warning: Missing a bust forces an expensive return trip later.
speedrun: Room size and the first bust position help predict which side contains the remaining objective.

title: Check your level before The Docks
summary: Catch up only if needed, then take the Battlefront ribbon spool and continue to The Docks.
why: Being too far below the area level reduces experience and can leave damage or defenses behind the route.
speedrun: Kill dense magic packs while moving; do not stop for isolated tanky rares just to satisfy a level target.

title: Defeat Dominus and enter the Aqueduct
summary: Reach the rooftop, finish both phases, then take the exit straight into Act 4.
details: Bleed removal is valuable for the second phase.
Keep the arena transition path clear of dropped items and unnecessary interactions.
speedrun: The upper Sceptre uses repeating rotations; recognize the stair pattern instead of clearing each room.

title: Kill Voll and take Deshret's Banner
summary: Cross the Dried Lake, defeat Voll, take the banner, and use it at the mine entrance.
warning: Confirm Deshret's Banner dropped before leaving Voll's arena.
speedrun: The Dried Lake is open; commit to broad directional sweeps instead of checking every edge.

title: Defeat Malachai and finish Act 4
summary: Complete the three organ wings, defeat Malachai, and speak to Dialla to reach Act 5.
details: Treat each organ boss as a checkpoint and refill flasks between encounters when practical.
Malachai's arena punishes standing still; prioritize survival over squeezing in one extra attack.
speedrun: The organ order should minimize backtracking from the central harvest rather than follow perceived difficulty.

title: Defeat Kitava and prepare for the resistance penalty
summary: Finish the Act 5 Kitava encounter, then immediately reassess elemental resistances in Act 6.
details: After Kitava, all elemental resistances are reduced by 30%.
Use the crafting bench to patch the weakest resistance before continuing.
why: The campaign's second half assumes you compensate for the first permanent resistance penalty.
warning: Do not judge your defenses by the values you had before this fight.

title: Clear the Twilight Strand for Lilly Roth
summary: Remove every undead monster from the beach, then speak to Lilly to unlock her full gem shop.
details: This detour is especially valuable when your build transitions gems after Act 5.
Use the vendor search reminder before opening Lilly's inventory.
why: Lilly sells virtually every purchasable gem, making later build fixes much easier.

title: Defeat Tukohama for a permanent reward
summary: Enter the Karui Fortress, defeat Tukohama, and claim the Book of Skill in town.
warning: The passive-point turn-in is easy to forget because the main route continues elsewhere.
speedrun: Complete the fortress in the same pass through the Coast to avoid a later waypoint detour.

title: Defeat Abberath during the Prisoner's Gate pass
summary: Take the side passage, defeat Abberath, then continue the main route instead of returning later.
warning: This objective contributes a permanent passive-point reward after turn-in.

title: Defeat Ryslatha before leaving the Wetlands loop
summary: Finish Ryslatha while the route already has you in the Wetlands, then use the planned relog to town.
warning: Do not postpone permanent-reward side objectives when they are already on your route.

title: Defeat the Brine King
summary: Navigate the reef, finish the Brine King encounter, and return to Lioneye's Watch for the Act 7 transition.
details: Avoid getting trapped by the shrinking arena during the storm phases.
Cold and lightning resistance make mistakes less punishing.
speedrun: Keep moving during invulnerability phases so you are positioned for the next safe opening.

title: Kill Maligaro and secure the Black Venom
summary: Use the map device route, kill Maligaro, take the quest item, then portal back to Chamber of Sins.
warning: Take the Black Venom before using the return portal.

title: Defeat Greust while crossing the Ashen Fields
summary: Follow the road, finish Greust, and continue directly into Northern Forest.
warning: Remember the related permanent reward when the route next returns to town.

title: Defeat Gruthkul and take the Fireflies route
summary: Finish the Den, collect the permanent reward, and continue the planned Forest Encampment loop.
warning: Claim the Book of Skill when the route returns to town.
speedrun: Bundle optional-looking permanent-reward objectives into natural waypoint loops; never make a separate late-act trip.

title: Defeat Arakaali and enter Act 8
summary: Navigate the Temple of Decay, defeat Arakaali, and follow the bridge into the Sarn Ramparts.
details: Keep moving when web effects and adds begin to overlap.
The arena transition is the act exit; no town return is required.
speedrun: Temple floors use repeated edge and staircase cues—commit to the pattern instead of clearing dead ends.

title: Defeat Doedre and choose the efficient sewer exit
summary: Kill Doedre, use the correct sewer branch, and continue the Lunaris/Solaris objective loop.
details: Doedre's arena mechanics become safer when you actively use the valve rather than ignoring debuff stacks.
speedrun: The post-boss sewer choice determines which half of the act you reach; verify the next objective before leaving.

title: Defeat Solaris and Lunaris
summary: Bring both moon and sun orbs to the Harbour Bridge, defeat the sisters, and enter the Blood Aqueduct.
warning: You need both quest orbs before the final Act 8 encounter opens.
speedrun: Treat the two temple wings as one planned loop with waypoint returns, not two independent searches.

title: Kill the Basilisk and take the Acid
summary: Finish the Basilisk objective during the Vastiri route, take the quest item, then relog to Highgate.
warning: Take the Acid before leaving the area.

title: Defeat Shakari before returning to Highgate
summary: Find the sand pit, kill Shakari, then use the planned relog back to town.
warning: Claim the associated Book of Skill on the next Highgate stop.

title: Defeat Garukhan for the passive point
summary: Complete the Garukhan side objective while already passing the Quarry, then claim its Book of Skill.
why: This permanent reward is worth the short detour and should not be postponed until after the campaign.
speedrun: The Quarry is a hub—finish every required branch before committing to the Belly of the Beast route.

title: Kill General Adus and take the Trarthan Powder
summary: Follow the refinery route to the quest icon, kill Adus, take the powder, then relog to Highgate.
warning: Take the Trarthan Powder before leaving the refinery.

title: Defeat the Depraved Trinity
summary: Complete the Rotting Core, defeat all three bosses, and take the route to Oriath Docks.
details: Focus on the currently vulnerable target and keep the center clear for transitions.
speedrun: Use the transition created after the encounter; there is no reason to backtrack through the core.

title: Kill Plaguewing on the way into Ravaged Square
summary: Take Plaguewing during the rooftop route, then continue immediately into Ravaged Square.
warning: Its reward is bundled into a later town turn-in, so do not forget it when you return to Lani.

title: Defeat Avarius and return to Oriath Docks
summary: Follow the Desecrated Chambers edge route, kill Avarius, then waypoint directly back to town.
warning: The later Lani turn-in can include a permanent reward from this route.

title: Defeat Vilenta for the final optional passive point
summary: Take the Control Blocks detour, defeat Vilenta, and claim the Book of Skill before finishing the campaign.
warning: This is optional for story progression but not optional for a complete passive-point total.
speedrun: Do it during the natural Control Blocks pass; returning after Kitava is slower.

title: Defeat Kitava and enter maps
summary: Finish the final campaign encounter, claim pending quest rewards, and verify permanent passives with /passives.
details: Kitava applies another 30% resistance penalty for a total campaign penalty of 60%.
Before mapping, cap elemental resistances, check flask setup, finish Labyrinth plans, and review your first gear checkpoint.
why: This is the transition from campaign routing to atlas progression.
warning: Entering maps with uncapped elemental resistances is one of the most common and avoidable early failures.

title: Audit permanent rewards before mapping
summary: Type /passives in Path of Exile and compare the result with ExileQuesting before you begin maps.
warning: Fix missing passive quests now; they become much easier to forget once atlas progression begins.
why: The in-game /passives command is the authoritative final check for campaign passive-point quests.
